flow_crowd.name: A direction in common
flow_crowd.description: A walk-in crowd follows a shared route field around an island. Carry the familiar point toward A or B; trigger shows or hides floor arrows; release returns the same 24 bodies. Each body reads the field, not its neighbours.
flow_crowd.qfep_connection: A collective turn can come from a prepared field without agreement between individuals. Visible directions expose that shared arrangement; the assigned parking places expose another supplied choice.
